summary: Weekend badge provisioning, landing-zone desk staging, and fragile lab gear courier for satellite office
description:
Issue summary: Engineering team (AI Research) is moving a small lab kit (5 x fragile units: custom GPU enclosures + calibrated USB measurement rigs) into our Redwood satellite office (Building B, 3rd floor) on Saturday 2026-03-14. Request is for (1) temporary weekend badge access for 6 staff, (2) pre-staging of two landing-zone desks with dual monitors and docks, and (3) coordination with our approved courier for fragile equipment pickup and secure delivery to the satellite office. Impact: If access/staging/courier are not confirmed by Friday EOD, move will be delayed to next week, blocking an internal demo scheduled for 2026-03-16. Deadline: Need badge provisioning and desk staging confirmation by 2026-03-13 18:00 PST. Requested owner: Facilities + Security to approve weekend badges; Logistics to book soft-handling courier slot and provide tracking; Office Ops to stage desks and power.

Environment/context: Onsite move to Building B (satellite), parking/loading dock B2 available Saturday 06:00-09:00. Equipment is labeled as fragile and requires two-person signoff at delivery. Team lead: Alex Kim (ext. 4221).
steps_to_prepare: 1) Approve weekend badge exceptions for six users (list provided below). 2) Provision temporary floor access to 3rd floor lab corridor for 06:00-14:00 on 2026-03-14. 3) Reserve two adjacent landing-zone desks (3C-02, 3C-03) and stage with two 27" monitors, two docks, two ethernet drops, and power strips. 4) Confirm courier pickup window Saturday 05:30-06:30 from central office loading dock A1; ensure two-person handling and fragile labeling. 5) Escort requirement: security escort to server-adjacent room for short access window; coordinator to meet courier at loading dock. 6) Verify inventory and capture photo sign-off at arrival.
equipment_manifest:
- 2x custom GPU enclosures (fragile)
- 3x calibrated USB measurement rigs
- 5x power bricks and cabling bundles
- 1x rack-mount kit (boxed)
Items labeled with internal tags: RWI-ALX-01..05
logs_and_tracking: Courier preliminary booking: Redwood Logistics (internal vendor ID RL-78), tentative manifest ID RL-2026-03-14-ALX. Ticketing note: Access control check on 2026-03-10 shows no weekend exceptions for listed users. Loading dock calendar shows slot A1 open 06:00-07:00 on 2026-03-14. Security runbook referenced: https://confluence.redwood/team/facilities/runbooks/weekend-access

investigation_notes: Checked access-control logs: no existing weekend exceptions for this user group. Requires manual exception creation and badge schedule entry.
Checked stockroom: 2x 27" monitors in stock, 2x docking stations low on spares but available after redistribution; reserve confirmed.

Courier evaluation: RL-78 has prior fragile-handling certification; past incident rate 0.6% for minor damage (internal vendor report Q4 2025). Insurance coverage on file covers replacement cost up to $25k per shipment.
resolution_notes: TBD - in progress. Will add final sign-off and delivery photos after Saturday operation.

Logistics to add RL-78 courier rating to vendor registry after completion.
Office Ops to reconcile monitor/dock inventory and replenish stockroom if depleted.
